She is pulling a black suitcase with a grey bag on top. Behind her, blurry figures of other travelers and purple self-service kiosks are visible under bright, even indoor lighting. (2) As she approaches the camera, she stops walking and faces the lens directly. She reaches up with her right hand to pull down a pink protective mask, revealing her smiling face and bright eyes. The background shows a large lit billboard with a family portrait and airport signage including the number 16. The scene is clean and high-contrast, emphasizing her reveal. (3) She stands stationary, posing for the camera with a playful and affectionate expression. She adjusts her posture and tilts her head slightly, keeping her gaze fixed on the viewer. The reflective airport floor captures the silhouettes of the objects around her. The camera remains steady at eye-level, capturing her upper body and the top of her luggage in a medium shot.
